subject.title: [Feature]: Catch up on missed inbound messages after gateway restart

question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel missed-inbound catch-up contract now, and should Slack and Discord be the first provider-owned implementations?
rationale: The iMessage precedent proves the recovery pattern, but generalizing it changes channel API boundaries, provider permissions, config/default behavior, replay ordering, and duplicate-response safety.

options.title: Design contract and pilot Slack/Discord
options.body: Define durable cursor/dedupe and replay policy first, then land narrow Slack and Discord implementations with live proof and upgrade-safe config semantics.

options.title: Land restart queue work first
options.body: Keep this issue open while prioritizing adjacent SIGUSR1 and follow-up queue persistence work before provider-history replay.

options.title: Split per-provider only
options.body: Track Slack, Discord, and other channel catch-up separately if maintainers do not want a generic channel contract yet.

recommendation.title: Design contract and pilot Slack/Discord
recommendation.body: Define durable cursor/dedupe and replay policy first, then land narrow Slack and Discord implementations with live proof and upgrade-safe config semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history spans Slack, Discord, iMessage, and state/docs surfaces relevant to choosing the cross-channel replay boundary.
